review_description: I had 10.79KW system installed from Green Solar in Dec 2022, for 1 year, i have monitored my bill, unfortunately i have been vey frustrated and dissatisfied with the results. I was promised a reduction upto 91% in my bill, where as i have hardly got 10-20% reduction overall which amounts to the same money i am paying over emi to them. On top of this all my calls /emails to green solar team are unanswered, so say goodbye to after sales service . Last development is that in order to get the problem identified , i took help of another technician, they had a look at the inverter and mentioned that its heating more than usual and could be a safety hazard, which has left me scared now. I have lost all faith in solar companies post this experience . So in a nutshell pls avoid this company its a waste of time and money.

Paul at Green Solar and his install team of Paul and George are absolutely amazing at what they do and I cannot recommend them highly enough. I have just had my 3rd system installed by this amazing team and I am once again super impressed with the quality of the designing phase, quoting process, overall value for money and professional installation works. Many many thanks again team!

Quoting process went great. Anna on the phone was polite and decent knowledge of the products they sell with honest feedback on products they have installed. Not the cheapest installer but they've been in business for a while now and hence decided to stick with this mob. However, do consider where the antenna position is and any other items that may impact installation before the day of install. This was not really explained.Installation happened in less than two weeks of deposit payment. Mahmoud and his team were punctual, polite, friendly and helpful in explaining their work and any changes they think was required to the roof. They were tidy in their workThey organised everything with grid so i didn't really have worry about anything that side. Only had to deal with my energy retailer (AGL). The guys struggled a bit with setting up the wireless monitoring as the website of the Inverter manufacturer (Solis) wasn't up to scratch. Figured things on my own with that sense. Wasn't too hard.Early days but so far the experience has been great. Thanks Guys!
Only been on 4 days, but everything is looking great, nice team good installers
